import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query all stations with their coordinates and compute nearest-neighbor distances
query = text("""
WITH station_coords AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        name_en,
        ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS lon,
        ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS lat
    FROM air_quality_station
),
nearest_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id,
        a.name_en,
        MIN(ST_Distance(a.coordinate::geography, b.coordinate::geography)) AS nearest_distance
    FROM air_quality_station a
    CROSS JOIN air_quality_station b
    WHERE a.id != b.id
    GROUP BY a.id, a.name_en
)
SELECT name_en, nearest_distance
FROM nearest_distances
ORDER BY nearest_distance DESC
LIMIT 3
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)
